verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Graphite Agent automatically reviews all new PRs in the repositories you select. It documents no draft skipping, no on-demand trigger, and no branch or label filters. Repo-level enablement and comment exclusions are adjacent controls: they decide where reviews are switched on and what the bot comments on, not when a review runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I control when reviews run — skip drafts, trigger on demand, filter by branch or label — so the bot shows up only when wanted
